uncertainties.title: Geometry comparison review bookkeeping
uncertainties.question: Why does the merged geometry baseline retain a pending manual-review decision although issue #7 is closed?

resolution.answer: The pending decision was stale bookkeeping. The maintainer approved the four digest-bound restricted comparison reports, and the tracked geometry baseline records that approval without changing Geometry Identities.
